# ReadMe

- This is the analysis script for the Prediction vs Inductive Inference study.  
- Date run: 11/7/25
- N = 105 before exclusions
- 2 between-subjects conditions: Prediction task vs Inductive Inference task.
- DV: If x happens, what will happen next? (Prediction), if creature can do x, what else can it do? (Inductive inference), IV: Binary choice between CC vs CO event (Prediction), Binary choice between CC vs CO item (Inference).
- Hypothesis: subjects choose CC item for predicting next event, and CO item for inferring what other capacity a creature will have.

# Confirmatory Analysis - Prep

The main confirmatory analysis asks what proportion of subjects select the CC vs CO item in each condition. 

## Read data

```{r}
data_path_pr <- paste0(base_path, "/data/4_inference_v_prediction/JO-mbc-main-v2-prediction-105N")

desired_order <- c("see something", "hear something", "choose what to do", 
                   "remember something", "think about something", "reach for something", 
                   "sit down", "jump up and down", "kick something", "take a walk", 
                   "get tired", "become hungry", "feel scared", "experience pain", "get sick")

file_paths <- list.files(path = data_path_pr, pattern = "^2025-", full.names = TRUE)

d_pr <- imap_dfr(file_paths, ~ {
  read_csv(.x, col_types = cols(response = col_character())) %>%
    rename(
      CC_item = causal_itemA,
      CO_item = similar_itemA,
      selected_item = selected_choice
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      filename = basename(.x),
      subject_id = paste0("subj_", str_pad(.y, 2, pad = "0"))
    )}) %>%
  select(-c(mturk_participant_id, mturk_assignment_id, mturk_project_id)) %>%
  relocate(subject_id, .before = "success")

rmarkdown::paged_table(d_pr)

```

## Wrangle data

```{r}
subjects_to_exclude <- d_pr %>%
  filter(grepl("attention_check", condition)) %>% 
  mutate(attn_correct = correct_response_attn == selected_item) %>%
  filter(attn_correct == FALSE) %>% 
  pull(subject_id) %>% 
  unique()

dat_pr <- d_pr %>% 
  filter(!subject_id %in% subjects_to_exclude) %>% 
  filter(condition %in% c("event_prediction", "trait_inference")) %>%
  mutate(response = ifelse(response == "causal", "CC", "CO")) %>% 
  mutate(response = as.factor(response)) %>% 
  mutate(condition = ifelse(condition == "event_prediction", "Prediction", "Inference")) %>% 
  mutate(condition = as.factor(condition)) %>% 
  mutate(condition = fct_relevel(condition, c("Prediction", "Inference"))) %>% 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(response = case_when(
    grepl(CC_item, selected_item) ~ "CC",
    grepl(CO_item, selected_item) ~ "CO",
    TRUE ~ "other"
  )) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(response = fct_relevel(response, c("CO", "CC"))) %>% 
  select(subject_id, condition, itemB, CC_item, CO_item, response) %>% 
  mutate(CC_item = factor(CC_item, levels = desired_order),
         CO_item = factor(CO_item, levels = desired_order),
         itemB = factor(itemB, levels = desired_order)) %>% 
  mutate(domain_itemB = case_when(itemB == "hear something" ~ "mind", #labels for first item of pair
                                 itemB == "choose what to do" ~ "mind",
                                 itemB == "remember something" ~ "mind",
                                 itemB == "think about something" ~ "mind",
                                 itemB == "see something" ~ "mind",
                                 itemB == "reach for something" ~ "action",
                                 itemB == "sit down" ~ "action", 
                                 itemB == "jump up and down" ~ "action",
                                 itemB == "kick something" ~ "action",
                                 itemB == "take a walk" ~ "action",
                                 itemB == "get tired" ~ "body", 
                                 itemB == "become hungry" ~ "body",
                                 itemB == "feel scared"~ "body",
                                 itemB == "experience pain"~ "body",
                                 itemB == "get sick"~ "body"),
         domain_CC_item = case_when(CC_item == "hear something" ~ "mind", 
                                 CC_item == "choose what to do" ~ "mind",
                                 CC_item == "remember something" ~ "mind",
                                 CC_item == "think about something" ~ "mind",
                                 CC_item == "see something" ~ "mind",
                                 CC_item == "reach for something" ~ "action",
                                 CC_item == "sit down" ~ "action", 
                                 CC_item == "jump up and down" ~ "action",
                                 CC_item == "kick something" ~ "action",
                                 CC_item == "take a walk" ~ "action",
                                 CC_item == "get tired" ~ "body", 
                                 CC_item == "become hungry" ~ "body",
                                 CC_item == "feel scared"~ "body",
                                 CC_item == "experience pain"~ "body",
                                 CC_item == "get sick"~ "body"),
          domain_CO_item = case_when(CO_item == "hear something" ~ "mind", 
                                 CO_item == "choose what to do" ~ "mind",
                                 CO_item == "remember something" ~ "mind",
                                 CO_item == "think about something" ~ "mind",
                                 CO_item == "see something" ~ "mind",
                                 CO_item == "reach for something" ~ "action",
                                 CO_item == "sit down" ~ "action", 
                                 CO_item == "jump up and down" ~ "action",
                                 CO_item == "kick something" ~ "action",
                                 CO_item == "take a walk" ~ "action",
                                 CO_item == "get tired" ~ "body", 
                                 CO_item == "become hungry" ~ "body",
                                 CO_item == "feel scared"~ "body",
                                 CO_item == "experience pain"~ "body",
                                 CO_item == "get sick"~ "body"))
```

## Summarize data

```{r}
# Trial-level summary
dat_trial_summarized <- dat_pr %>%
  unite("joined", c(itemB, CC_item, CO_item), sep = "_") %>% 
  group_by(condition, joined) %>%
  mutate(total = n()) %>% 
  group_by(condition, joined, response) %>%
  summarize(
    count = n(),  
    total = first(total), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  tidyr::complete(condition, joined, response, fill = list(count = 0)) %>% 
  group_by(condition, joined) %>%
  fill(total, .direction = "downup") %>%
  mutate(
    mean_proportion = count / total,
    se = sqrt(mean_proportion * (1 - mean_proportion) / total),
    ci_low = pmax(0, mean_proportion - 1.96 * se),
    ci_high = pmin(1, mean_proportion + 1.96 * se)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() 

rmarkdown::paged_table(dat_trial_summarized %>% 
                         separate(joined, 
                                  into = c("itemB", "CC_item", "CO_item"), 
                                  sep = "_"))

# Condition-level summary
dat_condition_summarized <- dat_pr %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(total = n()) %>% 
  group_by(condition, response) %>%
  summarize(
    count = n(),  
    total = first(total), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  tidyr::complete(
    condition,
    response = c("CO", "CC"),
    fill = list(count = 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  fill(total, .direction = "downup") %>%
  mutate(
    mean_proportion = count / total,
    se = sqrt(mean_proportion * (1 - mean_proportion) / total),
    ci_low = pmax(0, mean_proportion - 1.96 * se),
    ci_high = pmin(1, mean_proportion + 1.96 * se)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

rmarkdown::paged_table(dat_condition_summarized)

```

## Specific relations reported in paper

### Jumping -> tired vs walk

```{r}
#jumping is much more likely to make someone get tired than to make them take a walk
dat_jump <- dat_pr %>% 
  filter(condition == "Prediction",
         itemB == "jump up and down",
         CC_item == "get tired",
         CO_item == "take a walk") %>% 
  mutate(direct_binary = ifelse(response == "CC", 1, 0))

#mean proportion choosing tired
model_jump_prop <- glm(direct_binary ~ 1,
                  family = binomial,
                  data = dat_jump)

summary(model_jump_prop)
plogis(coef(model_jump_prop[1]))
plogis(confint(model_jump_prop))

#CIs for beta
model_jump <- glmer(
  response ~ 1 + (1 | subject_id),
  data = dat_jump,
  family = binomial)

summary(model_jump)
standardize_parameters(model_jump)

```

### Hearing -> see vs scared

```{r}
#hearing is just as likely to make someone see something as to make them feel scared
dat_hear <- dat_pr %>% 
  filter(condition == "Prediction",
         itemB == "hear something",
         CC_item == "feel scared",
         CO_item == "see something") %>% 
  mutate(direct_binary = ifelse(response == "CC", 1, 0))

#mean proportion choosing scared0
model_hear_prop <- glm(direct_binary ~ 1,
                  family = binomial,
                  data = dat_hear)

summary(model_hear_prop)
plogis(coef(model_hear_prop[1]))
plogis(confint(model_hear_prop))

#CIs for beta
model_hear <- glmer(
  response ~ 1 + (1 | subject_id),
  data = dat_hear,
  family = binomial)

summary(model_hear)

confint(model_hear)
standardize_parameters(model_hear)

```

## Item-level with distances

```{r, fig.height = 12, fig.width = 12}
#appending distances
d_distances <- read_csv(freesort_and_causal_pairs_distances_constrained_df_path)

rmarkdown::paged_table(d_distances)

### Then Plotting
dat_summarized_itemlevel <- dat_pr %>%
  group_by(condition, itemB) %>%
  mutate(total = n()) %>% 
  group_by(condition, itemB, response) %>%
  summarize(count = n(),  
            total = first(total), 
            mean_proportion = round(count / total, 2), 
            se = sqrt(mean_proportion * (1 - mean_proportion) / total),
            .groups = "drop")

mean_diff <- dat_summarized_itemlevel %>%
  filter(response == "CC") %>%
  mutate(condition = tolower(condition)) %>%
  select(itemB, condition, mean_proportion) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = mean_proportion) %>%
  mutate(meanPred_minus_meanInf = round(prediction - inference, 2)) %>%
  select(itemB, meanPred_minus_meanInf)

dat_labels <- dat_pr %>% 
  left_join(d_distances %>%
              rename(itemB = target_item),
            by = c("itemB", "CC_item", "CO_item")) %>% 
  mutate(itemB = factor(itemB, levels = desired_order)) %>% 
  distinct(itemB, CC_item, CO_item, 
           causal_pairs_distance_CC_item,
           freesort_distance_CC_item,
           causal_pairs_distance_CO_item,
           freesort_distance_CO_item,
           freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CC,
           freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CO) %>% 
  mutate(freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CO = round(freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CO, 2),
         freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CC = round(freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CC, 2),
         cds_minus_cdc = causal_pairs_distance_CO_item - causal_pairs_distance_CC_item,
         fdc_minus_fds = freesort_distance_CC_item - freesort_distance_CO_item,
         fdmcdc_minus_fdmcds = freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CC - freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CO) %>% 
  left_join(mean_diff, by = "itemB") %>%
  mutate(facet_label = paste0(itemB, 
                              "\n",
                              "CC: ", CC_item, 
                              "\n",
                              "cd,fd,f-c: (",
                              causal_pairs_distance_CC_item,
                              ",",
                              freesort_distance_CC_item,
                              ",",
                              freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CC,
                              ")",
                              "\n",  
                              "CO: ", CO_item, 
                              "\n",
                              "cd,fd,f-c: (",
                              causal_pairs_distance_CO_item,
                              ",",
                              freesort_distance_CO_item,
                              ",",
                              freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CO,
                              ")",
                              "\n",
                              "cdS - cdC: ",
                              cds_minus_cdc,
                              "\n",
                              "fdC - fdS: ",
                              fdc_minus_fds,
                              "\n",
                              "(f-cC) - (f-cS): ",
                              fdmcdc_minus_fdmcds,
                              "\n",
                              "meanPred(C) - meanInf(C): ",
                              meanPred_minus_meanInf
                              ))

#sort by itemB and extract the ordered facet labels
ordered_facet_labels <- dat_labels %>%
  arrange(itemB) %>%
  pull(facet_label)

#join labels + ordering AFTER labels exist
dat_summarized_itemlevel <- dat_summarized_itemlevel %>%
  left_join(dat_labels %>% select(itemB, facet_label), by = "itemB") %>%
  mutate(facet_label = factor(facet_label, levels = ordered_facet_labels))

#set facet_label as a factor with that order
dat_labels <- dat_labels %>%
  mutate(facet_label = factor(facet_label, levels = ordered_facet_labels))

p_itemlvl <- dat_summarized_itemlevel %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = condition, y = mean_proportion, fill = response)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", colour = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white", "grey80")) + 
  geom_errorbar(data = filter(dat_summarized_itemlevel, response == "CC"), 
                aes(ymax = mean_proportion + se,
                    ymin = mean_proportion - se),
                stat = "identity", position = "identity", width = 0.3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 15),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 18)) +
  labs(y = "Proportion",
       title = "main") +
```

# Confirmatory Analysis - Analysis

## Logistic regression

```{r}
d_model <- dat_pr %>%
  mutate(subject_id = factor(subject_id)) %>% 
  mutate(response = fct_relevel(response, c("CC", "CO"))) %>% 
  mutate(condition = factor(condition, levels = c("Prediction", "Inference")))

model_prediction_vs_inference <- glmer(response ~ condition + 
                                         (1 | subject_id), 
      family = binomial(link = 'logit'), 
      data = d_model)

summary(model_prediction_vs_inference)

std_parameters <- standardize_parameters(model_prediction_vs_inference, 
                                  ci = 0.95) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(OR = exp(Std_Coefficient),
         OR_low = exp(CI_low),
         OR_high = exp(CI_high)) %>% 
  rename("Log_odds" = Std_Coefficient) %>% 
  relocate(c("OR", "OR_low", "OR_high"), .before = "Log_odds")

std_parameters
```

## Get specific probabilities

```{r}
effects_data <- allEffects(model_prediction_vs_inference)
effects_df <- as.data.frame(effects_data$condition)
effects_df

```

# Exploratory Analysis - Prep

The exploratory distance analysis asks whether we can use the quantitative distances to explain variation in effect sizes across trials.  

## Append distances

```{r}
#appending distances
d_distances <- read_csv(freesort_and_causal_pairs_distances_constrained_df_path)

rmarkdown::paged_table(d_distances)
```

## Merge and save distances

```{r}
dat_pr_distances <- dat_pr %>% 
  left_join(d_distances %>%
              rename(itemB = target_item),
            by = c("itemB", "CC_item", "CO_item")) %>% 
  mutate(causal_pairs_distance_CC_item = round(causal_pairs_distance_CC_item, 2),
         freesort_distance_CC_item = round(freesort_distance_CC_item, 2),
         freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CC = round(freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CC, 2),
         causal_pairs_distance_CO_item = round(causal_pairs_distance_CO_item, 2),
         freesort_distance_CO_item = round(freesort_distance_CO_item, 2),
         freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CO = round(freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CO, 2))

rmarkdown::paged_table(dat_pr_distances)

write_csv(dat_pr_distances, "dat_prediction_distances.csv")

```

# Exploratory Analysis - Figures

## Prediction condition - y axis CC

```{r}
short_names <- c(
  "see something" = "see",
  "hear something" = "hear",
  "choose what to do" = "choose",
  "remember something" = "remember",
  "think about something" = "think",
  
  "take a walk" = "walk", 
  "jump up and down" = "jump",
  "reach for something" = "reach",
  "sit down" = "sit",
  "kick something" = "kick",
  
  "get sick" = "sick",
  "feel scared" = "scared",
  "become hungry" = "hungry",
  "experience pain" = "pain",
  "get tired" = "tired")

dat_pr_distances_wrangled <- dat_pr_distances %>% 
  unite("joined", c(itemB, CC_item, CO_item), sep = "_") %>% 
  group_by(condition, joined) %>%
  mutate(total = n()) %>% 
  group_by(condition, joined, response, freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CC,
           freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CO) %>%
  summarize(count = n(),  
         total = first(total), 
         mean_proportion = count / total, 
         se = sqrt(mean_proportion * (1 - mean_proportion) / total), 
         .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(ci_low = pmax(0, mean_proportion - 1.96 * se),
         ci_high = pmin(1, mean_proportion + 1.96 * se)) %>% 
  mutate(joint_distance_difference = freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CC - freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CO) %>%
  # mutate(joint_distance_difference = freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CO - freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CC) %>%
  arrange(mean_proportion) %>% 
  relocate(mean_proportion, .after = joined) 

d_prop_and_distances_prediction <- dat_pr_distances_wrangled %>% 
  filter(condition == "Prediction") %>% 
  filter(response == "CC")  %>% 
  separate(joined, into = c("itemB", "CC_item", "CO_item"),
         sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(joined = paste0("target: ", itemB, "\n", "CC: ", CC_item, "\n", "CO: ", CO_item))  %>% 
  mutate(
    itemB         = recode(itemB, !!!short_names),
    CC_item   = recode(CC_item, !!!short_names),
    CO_item  = recode(CO_item, !!!short_names)) %>% 
  mutate(labels = paste0("target: ", itemB, "\n", "CC: ", CC_item, "\n", "CO: ",
                         CO_item))  

#figure
fig_pred_distance <- d_prop_and_distances_prediction %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = joint_distance_difference, y = mean_proportion)) +
  geom_point(size = 5, alpha = .4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  #geom_text(aes(label = labels), size = 3, vjust = 1.3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
      title = "Prediction Condition",
       x = "Joint distance difference",
       y = "Proportion (CO)") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1), xlim = c(0,1)) +
  theme(
```

## Prediction condition - y axis CO

```{r}
short_names <- c(
  "see something" = "see",
  "hear something" = "hear",
  "choose what to do" = "choose",
  "remember something" = "remember",
  "think about something" = "think",
  
  "take a walk" = "walk", 
  "jump up and down" = "jump",
  "reach for something" = "reach",
  "sit down" = "sit",
  "kick something" = "kick",
  
  "get sick" = "sick",
  "feel scared" = "scared",
  "become hungry" = "hungry",
  "experience pain" = "pain",
  "get tired" = "tired")

dat_pr_distances_wrangled <- dat_pr_distances %>% 
  unite("joined", c(itemB, CC_item, CO_item), sep = "_") %>% 
  group_by(condition, joined) %>%
  mutate(total = n()) %>% 
  group_by(condition, joined, response, freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CC,
           freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CO) %>%
  summarize(count = n(),  
         total = first(total), 
         mean_proportion = count / total, 
         se = sqrt(mean_proportion * (1 - mean_proportion) / total), 
         .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(ci_low = pmax(0, mean_proportion - 1.96 * se),
         ci_high = pmin(1, mean_proportion + 1.96 * se)) %>% 
  mutate(joint_distance_difference = freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CC - freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CO) %>%
  # mutate(joint_distance_difference = freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CO - freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CC) %>%
  arrange(mean_proportion) %>% 
  relocate(mean_proportion, .after = joined) 

d_prop_and_distances_prediction <- dat_pr_distances_wrangled %>% 
  filter(condition == "Prediction") %>% 
  filter(response == "CO")  %>% 
  separate(joined, into = c("itemB", "CC_item", "CO_item"),
         sep = "_") %>%
  mutate(joined = paste0("target: ", itemB, "\n", "CC: ", CC_item, "\n", "CO: ", CO_item))  %>% 
  mutate(
    itemB         = recode(itemB, !!!short_names),
    CC_item   = recode(CC_item, !!!short_names),
    CO_item  = recode(CO_item, !!!short_names)) %>% 
  mutate(labels = paste0("target: ", itemB, "\n", "CC: ", CC_item, "\n", "CO: ",
                         CO_item))  

#figure
fig_pred_distance <- d_prop_and_distances_prediction %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = joint_distance_difference, y = mean_proportion)) +
  geom_point(size = 5, alpha = .4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  #geom_text(aes(label = labels), size = 3, vjust = 1.3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
      title = "Prediction Condition",
       x = "Joint distance difference",
       y = "Proportion (CO)") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0,1), xlim = c(0,1)) +
  theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 25),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 25),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 25),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 25),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = .5, size = 25),
        legend.position = "none") 

fig_pred_distance

fig_pred_distance <- ggsave("figures/prediction_distances_points-yCO.png", width = 6, height = 4,
                        plot = fig_pred_distance, bg = "white")
```

# Exploratory Analysis - Analysis

## Prepare for modelling

```{r}
dat_pr_distances_model <- dat_pr_distances %>% 
  mutate(joint_distance_difference = freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CC -
           freesort_minus_causal_pairs_distance_CO) %>% 
  mutate(subject_id = as.factor(subject_id)) %>% 
  mutate(response = fct_relevel(response, c("CO", "CC")))

```

## Prediction condition

```{r}
model_prediction_distances <- glmer(response ~ joint_distance_difference + (1 | subject_id),
    data = dat_pr_distances_model %>%
      filter(condition == "Prediction") %>%
      mutate(response = fct_relevel(response, c("CO", "CC"))),
    family = binomial(link = 'logit'))

summary(model_prediction_distances)

std_parameters <- standardize_parameters(model_prediction_distances, 
                                  ci = 0.95) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(OR = exp(Std_Coefficient),
         OR_low = exp(CI_low),
         OR_high = exp(CI_high)) %>% 
  rename("Log_odds" = Std_Coefficient) %>% 
  relocate(c("OR", "OR_low", "OR_high"), .before = "Log_odds")

std_parameters

```

## Inference condition

```{r}
model_inference_distances <- glmer(response ~ joint_distance_difference + (1 | subject_id), 
    data = dat_pr_distances_model %>% filter(condition == "Inference") %>% 
            mutate(response = fct_relevel(response, c("CC", "CO"))),
    family = binomial(link = 'logit'))

summary(model_inference_distances)

std_parameters <- standardize_parameters(model_inference_distances, 
                                  ci = 0.95) %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(OR = exp(Std_Coefficient),
         OR_low = exp(CI_low),
         OR_high = exp(CI_high)) %>% 
  rename("Log_odds" = Std_Coefficient) %>% 
  relocate(c("OR", "OR_low", "OR_high"), .before = "Log_odds")

std_parameters
```
